observations: Photo 0 shows a desktop computer setup with a CRT monitor on top of a tower case.
The monitor has a silver bezel and appears to be an older model.
The tower case is black with silver front panel, featuring a CD/DVD drive and possibly a floppy drive.
Cables are visible to the right of the tower, tangled and connected to a power strip or adapter.

No brand or model is visible on the monitor or tower in the photo.

Photo of the full set including keyboard and mouse.

response.reason: The seller claims it is a Compaq desktop, but no branding is visible in the photo. The condition and completeness of the set cannot be verified from one photo. Proof is needed to confirm brand, functionality, and completeness before pricing.
